title: The instance the landing gate picks lands its benchmark research in the real kb through the content lane, the other two kept archived
goal: repro pick names the instance the landing gate's rule picks; repro replay --instance N --item ST-apmeih5l puts its commits since the start commit on the item's work branch of current origin/main, the shared ledgers (_sources.csv, _anchors.csv, topic indexes, _gaps.md and doc2query expansions) merged keeping both sides; they land through backlog.py land on the content lane; check.py and kb-verify lint pass on the result; the frozen set's rag.py eval passes on main at least as many rows as on the best instance's checkout; the other two instances' bare copies under _cache/bench-repro/ are left as they are, none of their commits reaches the real origin, and nothing is published.

run:
import csv,sys
rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario'].startswith('repro')]
import json,subprocess
best=max((float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['metric']=='eval_passed'),default=None)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','--json','eval','--file','kb/public/_retrieval/repro_bench.csv','--root','public','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True)
if p.returncode not in (0,1) or best is None: print(p.returncode,best); sys.exit(1)
n=json.loads(p.stdout)['passed']; print('main',n,'best instance',best); sys.exit(0 if n>=best else 1)

import json,os,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bench_repro as b
rec,date,f=b.standings(b.read_rows(b.BENCH_RESULTS))
n=sorted(f,key=lambda k:(b.pick_key(f[k]),k))[0]
d=b.default_dir(); m=json.loads((d/b.MANIFEST).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
i=next(x for x in m['instances'] if x['n']==n)
added=subprocess.run(['git','--git-dir',i['bare'],'diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=A',m['rev'],'main','--','kb/public'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.split()
miss=[p for p in added if not os.path.exists(p)]
print('instance',n,'added',len(added),'missing here',len(miss),*miss[:5])
sys.exit(1 if miss or not added else 0)

import json,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bench_repro as b
rec,date,f=b.standings(b.read_rows(b.BENCH_RESULTS))
best=max((v['passed'] for v in f.values()),default=None)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','--json','eval','--file','kb/public/_retrieval/repro_bench.csv','--root','public','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True)
if p.returncode not in (0,1) or best is None: print(p.returncode,best); sys.exit(1)
n=json.loads(p.stdout)['passed']; print('main',n,'best instance (summed over areas)',best); sys.exit(0 if n>=best else 1)

notes: The chosen instance's commits are read from _cache/bench-repro/originN.git (S..main); replay them with cherry-pick or rebase --onto on the item's work branch, resolving the shared ledgers keeping both sides (another session's research may have moved them). Source ids are random (S-xxxxxxxx), so collisions are unlikely; anchors are re-made with factdiff.py anchor --file for reworded DOC facts. The other two bares stay as they are (they are gitignored evidence and never pushed). check.py and the lint pass before the work: they guard the replayed research against contract errors; the eval check fails until the chosen research lands. Orchestrator, 2026-10-15, before the claim: check 5 (every kb/public file the picked instance-3 added since 2170d88 exists in the tree) fails on the base (45 of 45 missing) and reads the replay clause. Check 6 compares main's frozen-set passed count with the picked record's eval_passed summed over areas (bench_repro.standings), as repro pick reads it; check 2 compared with a single area's row (max 5) and proved nothing. Check 6 passes on the base (main 24, best instance 24: main already passes as many rows, from research landed since 2170d88): it is a guard that the replay keeps main at or above the best instance, not a proof of the work. check.py, the lint and repro status/pick pass before the work by design (guards).
